title: Lane lint runs once per lane, at hand-off; batch CI runs lint first and cancels the rest when it goes red
why: Owner ruling R4, 14:56 CST Nov 10 ("yes D is approved", relayed by the retrospective session): no added wait in the usual case, and the full suite in batch CI is still the final check (roles-each-layer-proves-once).
note: Drop the lane lint at join and on the batch head (decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job). Batch CI runs lint first and cancels the rest of the run when lint goes red; the files in the red output name the lane to drop; the next run is the one that merges. First confirm whether CI cancels on the first failure and whether every red lint maps to one lane. Record lands in #2565 (time-limits-end-hangs-only); build after it merges. Plan branch restart-plan, stage 3.
